title: Iron's Spells More Interaction
description: Adds some cooperative elements to several add-on mods for Irons Spells
body:
For example, Irons adds Apotheosis gems.
However, the Addon mod does not add them.
Have you ever wondered why?
This mod solves that problem!
Apotheosis,Apotheosis Addidtions,alshanex familiars,T.O Magic,Cataclysm Spellbooks,Fantasy Ending,GTBCS Geomancy Plus,Legendary Spellbooks,Wind's Spellbooks, Add integration features for these
This mod lets you enjoy a more comfortable magical experience by adding gems like "Apotheosis" from the "Attribute Magic" addonmod by irons, as well as "Echo" from T.O. Magic, which is specifically designed for sound-based spells.
Tips: Please let me know if you need anything.
Iron's Spells 'n SpellbooksのとそのアドオンモッドとApotheosisを使っているときにIron'sが追加するapoの属性魔法GEMがアドオンモッドになくてイラっと来たことがあなたはあります
このmodはそんな問題を解決してあげます‼
T.O Magicの実装されていない残響も追加します‼
まあそれだけです
でもあなたの役に立つはずです
なんかほしい連携要素があれば私に連絡してください
